name: Midnight Club: Los Angeles - South Central
summary:
Midnight Club: Los Angeles - South Central is downloadable content for Midnight Club: Los Angeles. It adds the South Central area to the game’s open-world version of Los Angeles, expanding the map with new streets, races and activities.

The content was released in two forms: a free map expansion that added the new district, and a paid premium upgrade that added additional vehicles, races, missions, music, and customization content. It builds on the main game’s street-racing structure, with events and progression integrated into the expanded city.
